manifest.source: Pinned darwin-arm64 Claude Code 2.1.308 census plus a reviewed snapshot of Anthropic's official hook reference.

detection.notes: Pinned binary probes are digest-bound under packages/surface/vendors/claude/probes/claude@2.1.308; missing flags still degrade observation with warnings.

argv.notes: --session-id establishes new identity; --resume continues an existing identity and is never combined with --session-id.

hook.notes: Loopback HTTP bridge with bearer interpolation; SessionStart and Setup use the command forwarder because Claude 2.1.308 does not support HTTP for them. A print-mode process exits without awaiting StopFailure command hooks, so StopFailure must stay on HTTP.

transcript.notes: Durable JSONL is authoritative for message content; hook events remain authoritative for lifecycle. Besides user/assistant/system/attachment rows, 2.1.308 records per-request bookkeeping rows (api-request, api-request-shape, api-request-blob, atis-latch, cost-state) that are not conversation messages; api-request-blob rows carry message.role user or assistant without uuid or timestamp.

statusline.notes: Claude invokes the configured statusLine command with model, cost, context-window, workspace, and prompt-cache JSON on stdin (rate limits only for subscription accounts).

subagentStatusLine.notes: Claude invokes the configured child command with the currently visible task snapshot on stdin. Rolling tokenSamples omit timestamps, so consumers must use callback-time tokenCount for rate samples. Fields whose value is undefined are omitted from the JSON.

terminal.notes: Native TUI control only; semantic state is never parsed from terminal rendering.

claims.harness: Isolated --init-only, credential-less print, and loopback API-error print lanes (init, headless, api-error-<status>) recorded by an HTTP hook sink in the adapter hook shape, in packages/surface/vendors/claude/census/harness.mjs
Native TUI in a harness-owned PTY against a scripted loopback Messages API, then --resume by id (interactive, resume), in packages/surface/vendors/claude/census/interactive-lane.mjs

Exact artifact --version and --help in a disposable environment, SHA-256, and bounded static probes of the subagent status channel and hook-event inventory in packages/surface/vendors/claude/census/generate-model.mjs; reviewed invocation-grammar and hook-switch probe records beside them

claims.notes: Digest-pinned review of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks retrieved for the v2.1.308 adaptation and reconciled with the executable's bundled hook schemas. Documentation proves declared support, not execution on the pinned artifact.

limitations: Artifact integrity and controlled runtime captures currently cover only darwin-arm64; protected promotion still requires every configured platform.

No lane uses an account or credential. Print lanes reach the API-error path through a loopback Messages API; the interactive lane drives the native TUI against a scripted loopback model, so assistant text, tool choices, compaction summaries, and model-switch pricing inputs are synthetic while hook shapes, transports, and order are native.

Not reached by any lane: Setup outside --init-only, UserPromptExpansion, PermissionDenied (auto mode), TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, TeammateIdle, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, Elicitation, ElicitationResult, PostModelSwitch outside a /model switch, mcp_server on MCP tool events, scratchpad_dir, and PostToolUse(Bash) tool_response.bashEditDiff.
The official hook reference is mutable. Its reviewed summary is digest-pinned here, and a future candidate must repeat the review and census rather than inheriting this claim.
